name: Werewords
summary: Social deduction word-guessing game where villagers ask yes/no questions to find a secret word while werewolves mislead.
rules_text: Players are randomly given roles: Mayor, Seer, Werewolves, and Villagers. The Mayor learns a secret word from the app; the Seer also learns it; Werewolves may also learn it. Villagers ask the Mayor yes/no questions to deduce the word before time runs out. Mayor may only answer yes, no, maybe, or close. If the word is guessed in time, villagers initially win, but then Werewolves get a chance to guess who the Seer is; if they guess correctly, Werewolves steal the win. If the word is not guessed in time, players vote to identify a Werewolf; if they succeed, Villagers win, otherwise Werewolves win.
